children: AMC refinanced $3.97B via $2.0B first-lien notes due 2031 and new $850M 1L and $1.12B 2L term loans, funding tender/redemptions and repaying existing loans, extending most maturities to Oct 2031 and Oct 2033.
Material Details
Detail
AI Analyst View
Refinances $3.97B of existing debt
Reduces near-term refinancing risk and clarifies balance sheet path.
$2.0B first-lien notes due 2031
Locks in longer-dated secured funding; maturity push reduces 2027–2029 wall.
$850M new 1L term loan
Adds secured liquidity to execute tender, redemptions, repayments.
$1.12B new 2L term loan
Completes capital stack for refi; second-lien implies higher cost but extends runway.
98.8% of 7.5% 2029 notes tendered
Effectively removes legacy secured notes; follow-on redemption planned.
Maturities extended to 2031/2033
De-risks solvency timeline; interest expense terms not disclosed.

This is a late-stage confirmation of AMC’s multi-year balance sheet repair and maturity extension efforts. For a larger catalyst, investors need clarity on interest cost, EBITDA/FCF trajectory, and sustained box office to validate leverage reduction.
